purpose: Quantify full-model consequence of native TriAttention TF32 precision path; original frozen four modes remain separately identifiable.
gpu_policy: PPU workers on physical 0 and 7; H100 workers on physical 0 and 7; no shared physical GPU among our jobs.

new_policies.tf32_triangle_ieee: H100 native CUE IEEE only inside TriAttention, other matmul remains TF32; mixed precision diagnostic.
new_policies.tf32_triangle_corrected: Custom H100 CUDA RNE-once TriAttention adapted to native layout; entire attention implementation changes, so not a query-only ablation and not native CUE.
new_policies.confidence_head_ieee: Six H100 diagnostic cases: disable global matmul TF32 only in ConfidenceHead forward by class; custom triangle explicitly remains TF32. Not a promoted PPU policy.

training: No new training claim in this inference-focused round; previous backward-only full-training evidence retained separately.
data: Raw weights, activations, coordinates and gradients remain on their original server; aggregate scalar/hash reports only.
adapter_control_failure: Initial adapter returned four dimensions for 4D Q inputs although native low-level CUE retains five dimensions. Real caller [0] removed N instead of B. Initial corrected-mode model outputs and timings discarded; exact native rank assertion added; corrected models rerun.
precision_intent: No PPU workaround that imitates measured native query drift; native and corrected diagnostics remain separate.
